info.name: OCHF API - Role-Based (Student, Landlord, Admin)
info.description:
Postman Collection for Group 16 Capstone Project - Off-Campus Hostel Finder (OCHF) Backend API.

Categorized strictly by actor role: Student Endpoints, Landlord Endpoints, and Admin Endpoints. Common endpoints (such as Auth, OTP, Schools, Property details, Slots, and Reports) are duplicated and pre-configured with each role's tokens and context for seamless independent testing.

item.name: 1. Student Endpoints
item.description: Endpoints used by Students: registration, login, profile, OTP verification, browsing schools & hostels, booking inspection slots, managing decisions, viewing rent transactions, posting reviews, and reporting issues.

request.description: Register a new student account. Returns JWT token and sets nextStep to otp_verification.
Authenticate student credentials and save token to {{studentToken}}.
Fetch the authenticated student user profile and verification status.
Permanently delete student account and linked profile. Requires current password for confirmation.
Send a fresh 6-digit OTP code to the registered student email.
Resend OTP to student email (enforces 60-second cooldown and hourly rate limit).
Verify 6-digit OTP code to confirm student email.

query.description: Optional search keyword (e.g. unilag, yaba, ibadan)

request.description: List tertiary institutions and coordinates. Saves first school ID to {{schoolId}}.

item.name: Get University / Campus Details by ID

request.description: Retrieve details and geo-coordinates for a specific school.

item.name: Search Hostels (Distance to Campus, Price, Amenities)

request.description: Search available student hostels near chosen school with geo-distance calculation, budget filter, and amenities.

item.name: Get Hostel Details by ID (Shielded Contact)

request.description: Fetch complete hostel information. Contact info is shielded unless student is verified.

item.name: Get Open Inspection Slots for Hostel

request.description: Retrieve all available, open inspection time slots for a given property.
Book an open inspection slot for a verified hostel. Automatically confirms booking.
Retrieve all inspection requests and scheduled visits booked by the logged-in student.
Retrieve full details of an inspection booking where the student is a participant.
Accept the hostel after viewing. Automatically initializes rent transaction.
Reject hostel after inspection with feedback reason.
Cancel a pending or confirmed inspection booking.
View list of all accommodation payment transactions for the student.
Retrieve status and breakdown of a specific transaction.
Update the transaction state (e.g. mark payment in_progress or completed).
Leave rating (1-5) and feedback comment for a hostel after completed accepted inspection.
List all property reviews submitted by the logged-in student.
View ratings and tenant reviews for a given hostel.
Edit a review previously written by the student.
Remove a review written by the student.
Submit a moderation flag or complaint regarding a misleading hostel listing or landlord behavior.
List all reports and complaints submitted by the student.

item.name: 2. Landlord Endpoints
item.description: Endpoints used by Landlords / Providers: account registration & login, OTP verification, campus browsing, listing and managing hostel properties, generating inspection slots, reviewing & completing student inspection visits, tracking rent transactions, and viewing property feedback.

request.description: Register a property provider / landlord account.
Authenticate landlord credentials and save token to {{providerToken}} & {{landlordToken}}.
Fetch the authenticated landlord user profile and provider verification status.
Permanently delete landlord account and linked provider profile. Requires current password.
Send a fresh 6-digit OTP code to the registered landlord email.
Resend OTP to landlord email (enforces 60-second cooldown and hourly rate limit).
Verify 6-digit OTP code to confirm landlord email.

item.name: Browse Campuses (Select School for Property Listing)

query.description: Optional search keyword (e.g. unilag, yaba, ibadan)

request.description: View registered tertiary institutions to link property listings to a campus.
Retrieve campus details to compute proximity and walking/driving distance.
Publish a new hostel listing linked to a campus with photos, pricing, amenities, and location.
Retrieve all hostel listings owned and managed by the logged-in landlord.

item.name: Get Property Details by ID (Landlord View)

request.description: Retrieve full property listing details.
Browse other platform listings for market intelligence, pricing benchmarks, and competitor analysis.
Modify title, price, description, amenities, or availability of an existing listing.
Permanently remove a property listing from the platform.

item.name: Create Inspection Slots from Availability Windows

request.description: Generate granular 30-minute inspection slots from start/end availability windows.
View all inspection slots created across all owned properties.

item.name: Get Open Slots for Property (Landlord Check)

request.description: View current open slots for a specific property.
Delete an unbooked inspection slot.
Retrieve all inspection requests and scheduled visits booked by students on landlord properties.
Retrieve complete details of an inspection booking on landlord property.
Confirm or set specific inspection timestamp.
Decline an inspection request with a reason.
Reschedule an inspection booking to another available slot.
Mark inspection as successfully conducted after student visits property.
Mark inspection as missed if student failed to arrive.
View list of rent payment transactions received from students.
Retrieve breakdown and status of an incoming transaction.
Update transaction state (e.g. acknowledge receipt or update status).
View reviews and ratings submitted by students on landlord property.
Submit a moderation report against a student or problematic transaction.
List all reports and complaints submitted by the landlord.

item.name: 3. Admin Endpoints
item.description: Endpoints used by Platform Administrators: authentication, user management, student verifications, landlord verifications, property listing moderation, inspection oversight, dispute resolution, school management, and diagnostic email broadcasting.

request.description: Authenticate admin credentials and save token to {{adminToken}}.
Retrieve authenticated administrator account information.

item.name: Get All Platform Users (Filter by Role & Status)

request.description: Paginated user directory with role, status, and query search filters.
Suspend or reactivate a student, landlord, or admin account.
List pending student profile verifications awaiting review.

Approve or reject a provider/landlord account.
List pending hostel listings awaiting moderation and approval.
Approve or reject a property listing before it appears in public search.
Inspect live hostel listings across all campuses.

request.description: Inspect full property details including owner info.
List inspection bookings requiring admin moderation or review.
Admin override to confirm/approve an inspection booking.
Admin override to reject an inspection booking with a reason.

item.name: Get All Platform Inspections (Filter by Status)

request.description: Audit all platform inspections (requested, confirmed, completed, cancelled).
List open user and listing reports flagged by students or landlords.
Resolve, dismiss, or mark report as under investigation.
Add a new tertiary institution with geo-coordinates (latitude and longitude).
